attchmntText: Algoquant Fintech Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Algoquant Fintech Limited published a newspaper advertisement in the Financial Express on November 16, 2026, regarding its Unaudited Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026. The announcement confirms the publication of standalone and consolidated results in English and Gujarati languages. The results are also available on the company website at www.algoquantfintech.com. The filing was submitted pursuant to Regulation 30 and 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Mohd. Intzar, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the letter. The document includes details of various other companies and their financial data, but the primary action is the disclosure of Algoquant Fintech Limited's quarterly and half-yearly financial performance.

attchmntText: Algoquant Fintech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Algoquant Fintech Limited approved its Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Second Quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026. The results include a Limited Review Report from Statutory Auditors O P Bagla & Co. LLP. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a profit before tax of 3,013.77 lakh rupees and a profit for the period of 2,244.79 lakh rupees. Earnings per share were 0.80 rupees. Total assets stood at 37,446.64 lakh rupees as of September 30, 2026. The company also invested 52.50 lakh rupees in its subsidiary, AQ Capital Services Private Limited, through a rights issue.
